answer: Because the knoll reference is updated at each quill checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the echo audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 129 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 3 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
